turns.user: does that change what I'm eating as well, or just the training?
turns.reply:
It absolutely changes what you're eating, Ashley. Building muscle requires a calorie surplus—meaning you'll be eating more to fuel that new growth—whereas cutting kept you in a deficit to lose fat. 

If you confirm that goal change on the card, your daily targets will automatically shift from 1660 calories up to a surplus, and your meal portions will scale up to match. Your training will also rebuild to focus on the volume and rep ranges best suited for packing on muscle. 

It updates both sides of the equation so they work together. Want to go ahead and make the switch?
